categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Yanjan New Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of surface materials for disposable hygiene products. Its main products include 3D perforated non-woven fabrics and PE perforated films used in sanitary napkins, baby diapers, and other disposable hygiene products. The company also develops spunbond hot air non-woven fabrics, non-woven waistbands, composite films, and wipes as emerging product lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary 3D conical perforation technology to enhance liquid permeability of surface materials, outperforming traditional PE perforated films and non-perforated non-woven fabrics. It has independently developed core equipment for perforation molds and winding machines, achieving automated production processes including carding, perforation, surface treatment, online inspection, slitting, and winding. The company holds numerous patents in material improvement, structural optimization, process innovation, and equipment upgrades.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international manufacturers of disposable hygiene products such as sanitary napkins and baby diapers. The company maintains long-term strategic partnerships with major brands, supplying high-end product lines. Its products serve end markets including women’s hygiene, infant care, adult incontinence, and wipes sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China, Egypt, the United States, India, and Singapore. These overseas subsidiaries serve regional markets including Middle East, Africa, Mediterranean, North America, India, and Southeast Asia. Export sales constitute over 50% of total revenue, reflecting a strong international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen Yanjan operates primarily in the midstream segment of the disposable hygiene product supply chain, manufacturing key surface materials used by downstream hygiene product manufacturers. It sources raw materials such as ES fibers and plastic pellets from upstream petrochemical suppliers and delivers customized materials to downstream brand owners and manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to innovate surface materials with enhanced functionality such as breathability, antibacterial properties, and softness. It invests in expanding spunbond hot air non-woven fabric capacity and developing new products like wipes and foam cores. The firm aims to establish fiber supply capabilities and push R&D towards upstream fiber solutions to better meet evolving customer demands and global market trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of specialized surface materials and related products to hygiene product manufacturers. The company operates on an order-driven procurement and production model, providing customized product solutions and technical support to clients. Export sales and overseas production contribute significantly to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic suppliers penetrating the high-end product segment of disposable hygiene materials, holding a strong first-mover advantage. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers of non-woven fabrics and PE films, leveraging its patented technologies, global supply chain, and close customer relationships to maintain competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.48 billion, a 17.96% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.28 million, up 30.72%. Overseas sales accounted for 55.59% of revenue, with significant growth in perforated non-woven fabric sales. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 2.73 billion with steady growth and ongoing investments in capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiamen Yanjan emphasizes its advanced 3D perforation technology that significantly improves product performance, enabling customers to differentiate their hygiene products in competitive markets. Its global production footprint reduces logistics costs and enhances supply stability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, customized solutions, and long-term partnerships with leading brands provide a unique value proposition focused on innovation, quality, and international market responsiveness.
